notes_for_editor: No build date, builder, staffing or fire history in any source read (two pages, one PDF, one search). The 1949 move comes from the FFLA 2020 chapter report, which also covers Encino. The Encino Aermotor tower (erected on site July 1950, originally on the Kaibab NF) is a different structure from the L-4 house and should not be merged with it. The report is from 2020, so whether the L-4 still stands at Encino in 2026 is not confirmed. The brief's 1949 event checks out.
